why: jaw_lips has no value that closes below 2.5 cm2 or protrudes, so a params move cannot help. round_lips gives 0-6.6 cm2 (seal for /p/) and up to 1.6 cm protrusion (lip tube 2.6 cm, tract to 16.1 cm) plus small rounded opening, dropping F2 toward 870-1020 Hz for back rounded vowels. Retractable protrusion avoids the long_cast penalty on aa F1 (ceiling 854 would fall ~708 < 730 target) and iy F2.

cam_tongue's rail_start range [2.5,4] can never reach the alveolar place, so a swap is required. tip_tongue adds a tip blade sliding 0.3-5 cm behind the teeth that seals the full bore (/t/), while its body pad at stroke 1.3 seals the velar place (/k/). Two independent constrictions (tip under the palate + body pad toward the pharynx) give /er/ a chance to pull F3 down, especially together with round_lips.
